# Freshworks — Freshworks Startup Program

Partner-referred discount on the Pro plan of Freshworks products, at percentages set in each startup's Service Order Form, claimable within one year of signup; capped at 30 agents per product.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open, but needs an accelerator, VC or partner code |
| **Verification** | Partially verified — Official information was read, but some detail could not be inspected directly. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [💬 Customer Support](../categories/support.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | discount |
| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Discounts "must be claimed across all products of Freshworks that You may want to try, within one (1) year from the initial date of signup." |
| **When it ends** | Terms state that where a second product is subscribed within the first year, "the discount applied for the second year will be fifty (50%) percent", and that "any new subscriptions in the subsequent years will not be eligible for the startup discount and will be charged at standard rates." |


### Not covered

- existing paid Freshworks customers
- accounts exceeding thirty (30) agents per product

> **Stacking:** Terms state the Credit Model and Discount Model "are mutually exclusive and You shall not be allowed to migrate from one model to the other".

### Notes

NOT INSPECTABLE: the live program landing page could not be read — https://www.freshworks.com/startups/ and https://www.freshworks.com/freshworks-for-startups/ both 404, and https://www.freshworks.com/company/partners/startup-program/ now renders Freshworks' general partner-program content with no startup terms, so the current discount percentages and funding tiers could not be confirmed. The record is built on the Freshworks Startup Program Terms PDF (effective 9 February 2023). VENDOR SELF-CONTRADICTION: a Freshworks press release dated 11 November 2021 states "Companies can get going with up to $3,000 in credits for Freshstack, as part of the Freshworks Startup Program", but the later Terms state that from the Effective Date "only Discount Model shall apply for new customer registrations under the FSP" and that a participant "cannot migrate to Discount model" / "cannot be migrated to the Credit model". The more conservative, more recent Discount Model is what is recorded here; no credit amount is treated as published. Terms also state "Your startup investment (funding) shall meet our criteria, as more specifically called out in the Service Order Form" — the actual funding thresholds are not published. Imported from a verification sweep whose quote fidelity later failed audit in 13 of 22 sampled records. This entry was NOT independently re-audited, so the evidence quote may be a close paraphrase rather than the vendor's exact wording. Re-read the source before relying on precise phrasing.
